proposal.title: Convert Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 for Artemis/AIONix to technology-style specification chapters
proposal.reason: Preserve every existing specification description, relationship role and referenced ID in numbered chapters with named text parameters. Add the commercial offering kind and documented providers. Where supplied, release is a direct date already stated in the product or the supported Model II customer-release event. No sales forecasts or new standards-impact assessments are invented.

before.name: Autodesk AutoCAD 1.0 for Artemis/AIONix
before.description: Autodesk-owned 2D CAD for Artemis and Artemis PRO running AIONix. It provides typed coordinate entry, validated numerical geometry, a dual-display command/status and 800×600 drawing workspace, explicit Logix Mouse integration, professional line/blit acceleration, drawing exchange and supported pen-plotter output. Logix supplies funded development support, hardware, distribution and joint marketing; Autodesk retains software ownership and its cross-platform business.

specification.description: Autodesk owns and publishes this CAD application.
The technical edition defines the application and its supported professional configuration.
Sets development support, acceptance, distribution and software-rights responsibilities.
